site.title: Asahi Suenaga
site.description: I build intuitive open-source software at Michigan State University while studying computer science. I have a sharp eye for detail and I look for perfection in executing my ideas.

bio: I'm a computer science major at Michigan State University with a curiosity for how things work. I dabble in interface design and like to program in my free time. I believe there’s something irresistible in programming—that instant when code compiles and abstract logic becomes something real. But building isn't enough on its own; it has to be designed to actually work for people. That is why great software starts long before writing code. Every user flow, pixel, and interface choice must feel intentional and frictionless. Weaving my sharp eye for design with practical engineering, I translate user needs into clean systems. That intersection is where I operate. From initial concept to polished build, I craft software where design and code reinforce each other.

items.name: Apple Notes Clone
items.desc: Remade Apple Notes complete with local storage data persistence, custom rich-text editing, dynamic folder nesting, and a secure data-recovery system for deleted items.

items.name: Baroque Jigsaw Puzzles
items.desc: Crafted a mobile application in less than a week for the Anything X Contra hackathon where you play jigsaw puzzles with art from the Baroque period.

items.name: Hide Google AI
items.desc: Engineered a lightweight mutation observer script to dynamically scrub unwanted generative search elements from the DOM.

items.name: Rainbow Cursor
items.desc: Developed a lightweight Chrome extension that intercepts DOM to dynamically replace the default cursor caret with an animated gradient across Google Docs.
Automated finance outreach and coordinated branded tracks and engagement boosting activities with technical mentors for MSU's 300+ student-run hackathon.
Streamlined administrative operations by centralizing meeting minutes, registration forms, and attendance logs into a single, comprehensive master database.
